title: Creative AI placement design principles
limitations: Authored heuristics; no measured performance claim; evaluated 2026-10-04.

title: Uploaded display ads specifications
section: Animated and non-animated image ads; Regionally available ad sizes
summary: Raster uploads use fixed pixel sizes and 150 KB ceiling. Some listed dimensions have region restrictions. HTML5/AMPHTML are separate formats.
limitations: KB byte convention unstated. GIF animation rules excluded: this catalog supports still images only.

title: Responsive display specs
summary: Required headline, long headline, description, business name and automated CTA; required landscape and square imagery; optional logos.
limitations: No character algorithm or image file ceiling in this page. Recommendation 600-square differs from older guidance; current page preserved.

title: Create a responsive display ad
summary: RDA images/logos <=5120KB; final URL entered; manual CTA selection optional. Square1200 recommended on creation page.
limitations: Square recommendation conflicts with600-square dedicated specs page; min300 agrees. Byte/count algorithms unstated.

title: Responsive display best practices
summary: Avoid added copy, logos, collages and deceptive button graphics on images. Native assets are combined by the platform.
limitations: Its prose mentions 80-character description whereas the dedicated specs page says 90; catalog records a source conflict and uses dedicated specs for technical checks.

title: Demand Gen specs
summary: Native headline maximum 40, descriptions 90, name 25, final URL 2048; landscape, square, logo assets required; portrait optional.
limitations: At least one headline <=30 is a serving/Ad Strength qualification for Display. No counting algorithm or image file size specified here.

title: Performance Max specs
summary: Static image assets and native copy belong to asset groups. Feed-attached groups have different minimum requirements. CJK double-width characters count twice.
limitations: 5MB and 5120KB both used without byte convention. This catalog models non-feed groups only; video may be generated automatically by Google, outside this static foundation.

title: LinkedIn Single Image Ads specs
summary: 5 MB file ceiling; landscape and square desktop/mobile delivery; vertical mobile-only. Short-copy lengths are recommendations.
limitations: Counting algorithm and hard native text ceilings not documented on this page. Bounds for orientation do not prove all ratios in that rectangle are supported.

title: LinkedIn Carousel Ads specs
summary: Two to ten cards; 10 MB ceiling; square JPG/PNG and 1080-square recommended. Native copy lengths presented as recommendations.
limitations: Hard native text counting/limits and byte convention not specified.

title: LinkedIn Document Ads specifications
summary: 100 MB, 300 pages, one million words; PDF/DOC/DOCX/PPT/PPTX; lead-gen PDF only. Native intro max 3000 and headline max 200. PDFs require equal page sizes and flattened layers.
limitations: Word and character counting algorithms and exact byte convention unstated; hyperlinks only interactive after download.

title: Pinterest ad specs
summary: Standard PNG/JPEG: web 20MB, in-app 32MB; 2:3 recommended. Non-sales carousels: 2–5 cards, 20MB each, square or 2:3. Titles 100, descriptions 800.
limitations: Sales carousel subsection labels conflict (non-Sales heading beside sales-only rule); sales catalog profiles stay conditional. Byte/count algorithms unstated; safe zones must be mapped to documented reference canvas.

title: Pinterest organic Pin specs
summary: Image Pins accept BMP/JPEG/PNG/TIFF/WebP. Web max 20MB; mobile 1GB is a recommendation. Title max100, textbox max250, description max800.
limitations: Image safe-zone coordinates appear without a clearly identified reference canvas. Do not apply them as universal insets; mobile hard ceiling and static recommended ratio unresolved.

title: X Ads creative specs
summary: Image max5MB. Post max280 with links consuming23; app image ratios include square, landscape and portrait. Carousels2–6, consistent ratio; card title70 with truncation.
limitations: Not every format available self-serve. Full weighted Unicode/link counting requires publisher implementation; current helper deliberately returns unknown.

title: X posting photos
summary: Photos up to5MB. Photo attachments do not consume post characters.
limitations: Account-level text allowance and multilingual counting not inferred from paid specifications.

title: Reddit image ad specs
summary: Image3MB; ratios1:1,4:5,4:3,16:9. Headline300; destination268. Conversation thumbnail400x300, under500KB; concise first80 recommended.
limitations: Publisher learning article, not upload acceptance test. Byte and character counting conventions unspecified.

title: TikTok Ad Network asset specs
summary: September2026 image specs distinguish network from TikTok feed. Standard image sizes1200x628,640x640,720x1280; exclusive banners600x500,640x200,640x100. JPG/JPEG/PNG,100MB.
limitations: Eligibility, region, native fields and byte convention require campaign configuration.

title: TikTok Reservation Takeover
summary: Static fallback JPG/JPEG/PNG <=500KB; six listed screen sizes or1242x2208. Avoid transparency, watermarks and imitation UI; URL required.
limitations: Reservation format and fallback; not universal self-serve feed image support. Licensing and eligibility need assignment evidence.

title: TikTok ad creation
summary: TikTok carousel carries images; Global App Bundle supports image/video. Objectives influence fields.
limitations: A static image carousel can involve required audio. Audio delivery and native campaign setup outside current foundation.

title: Snapchat ad formats
summary: Single Image/Video, Story and Collection include static-image use cases.
limitations: Overview does not provide numeric static technical specs.

title: Snapchat Single Image specifications
limitations: Official Help Center returned Loading/CSS Error. Numeric specs not adopted from third parties.

title: Instagram photo resolution
limitations: HTTP429; organic technical/caption limits unknown; no paid-to-organic inheritance.

title: Apple notification guidance
summary: Concise informative native text; complete sentences; system truncates as necessary.
limitations: Direct document requires JavaScript. Official search excerpt supports qualitative guidance only; no numeric limits adopted.

title: Android notification design
summary: Native title and content, optional picture. Titles single-line truncated. Good title <=30; body40 guidance. Expanded picture differs from collapsed icon.
limitations: 30/40 are design recommendations in template context, not universal transport hard limits. Rendering varies by OS/device/font.

title: WHATWG Notifications standard
summary: Native title/body plus optional image/icon/badge. Graphic and action support depends on implementation; essential meaning needs accessible fallback.
limitations: No universal character or image-pixel limit. Browser/OS/push-provider contract must be supplied.

title: Google Merchant Center image_link
summary: Exact item/variant imagery without added promotions or borders; <=64MP, <=16MB. Generative imagery needs AI metadata. Page announces500-square minimum from2027-01-31 but table already lists it.
limitations: Internal effective-date ambiguity: do not backfill old100/250 minima. Confirm current account minimum; pending500-square treated as future rule, not unconditional2026 limit.

title: Shopify product media types
summary: Product/collection images up to5000x5000 or25MP and smaller than20MB. Square2048 recommended. Theme determines displayed crop.
limitations: Byte convention ambiguous; theme template and format support need job inputs.

title: YouTube custom thumbnail guidance
summary: Current recommendation3840x2160 for video; minimum width640. Mobile video2MB/podcast10MB; desktop50MB. Podcast square. Vertical source may replace16:9 with4:5 on some surfaces.
limitations: Aspect/resolution text framed as recommendations. Shorts upload workflow and availability need separate verification; not copied old1280/2MB universal rule.

title: Responsive images
summary: Artboard pixels, layout width and device pixel ratio differ. Use responsive variants for rendered context.
limitations: Engineering guidance; no universal hero ratio or pixel dimensions.

title: Mailchimp email imagery guidance
summary: Image-blocking can hide baked copy; use text alternatives and optimize images for email delivery.
limitations: No universal email/client upload ceiling. Provider, template width, client and dark-mode rendering must be specified.

title: Adobe PDF output options
summary: Trim, bleed and printer marks are separate; output color conversion and PDF presets depend on printing conditions.
limitations: Does not establish a universal bleed, DPI, CMYK profile or printer acceptance.

title: OAAA OOH basics
summary: OOH includes multiple media environments; operator-specific production rules must be supplied.
limitations: Overview is coverage evidence only, not a numeric specification sheet. Viewing-distance guidance is editorial below.

title: W3C WAI Images tutorial
summary: Meaningful imagery needs appropriate text equivalents; decorative and complex images differ.
limitations: Applied as accessible delivery guidance unless assignment explicitly requires WCAG conformance.

title: WCAG2.2 contrast explanation
summary: AA text contrast4.5:1, large text3:1, with logo/incidental exceptions. Image-editor type sizes are not displayed CSS text sizes.
limitations: Not a universal ad acceptance rule. Applicable web conformance obligations must be supplied; rendered review remains necessary.
